manifest.name: POS Self Order
manifest.summary: Addon for the POS App that allows customers to view the menu on their smartphone.

models._description: Custom links that the restaurant can configure to be displayed on the self order screen

behavioral_notes.observation: The public QR-menu / kiosk entry point. start_self_ordering renders the standalone OWL self-order SPA (template pos_self_order.index) for anyone hitting /pos-self/<config_id>. _verify_entry_access gates access by self_ordering_mode (404 if 'nothing'), optionally matches a per-config access_token, resolves the table from a table_identifier query arg, and re-binds the public request to the config's company and to self_ordering_default_user_id (sudo(False).with_user(...)) so an anonymous diner acts with a constrained POS user's rights. This anonymous-to-POS-user impersonation and mode-based gating is not visible in metadata.

pos.config gains self_ordering_mode in {nothing, consultation (QR menu, read-only), mobile (QR menu + ordering), kiosk} plus service_mode {counter, table}. _get_self_order_route builds the customer URL (appends ?access_token=... and &table_identifier=... for table service), _get_self_order_url shortens it through the link.tracker dependency, and _get_qr_code_data / get_pos_qr_order_data render per-table or generic QR codes into a downloadable PNG/SVG zip. write() enforces mode-coupled rules (kiosk or counter-mobile forces pay_after='each'); a constraint forbids cash payment methods in kiosk mode. This QR/URL/access-token machinery is the access layer of the self-order channel and is pure Python.

A customer order placed in the browser app POSTs to /pos-self-order/process-order/<device_type>/. The server builds a sanitized order dict via pos.order._check_pos_order (re-maps taxes, derives tracking_number with a K<config>- prefix for kiosk vs S for mobile, stamps source='kiosk'|'mobile' and session_id=config.current_session_id.id), calls sudo().sync_from_ui([...]) to create the pos.order inside the currently OPEN pos.session, then recompute_prices() re-prices every line server-side to defeat frontend tampering. The customer-created order is thereby injected into the same shared session a cashier is running; free (amount_total==0) orders auto-finalize via _process_saved_order. This cross-actor sync is invisible to metadata.

After every self-order create / cancel / remove, pos.order._send_notification pushes a longpolling bus message (notify_synchronisation + _notify('ORDER_STATE_CHANGED')) to the config's current_session_id so the cashier POS UI and kiosk screens live-refresh. pos.session._load_pos_data_read injects a computed _self_ordering flag telling the main POS client a kiosk/mobile config exists. Kiosk payment runs from /kiosk/payment/.../<device_type>, which (after re-running process_order) calls payment_method._payment_request_from_kiosk against a supported terminal (adyen/razorpay/stripe/pine_labs/viva_com). These real-time bus side-effects and the kiosk-terminal handshake are not in metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: frontend (separate customer-facing OWL self-order SPA) -- gap #3 exemplar
behavioral_notes.observation: pos_self_order ships a SECOND standalone OWL single-page app distinct from the cashier POS terminal: entry static/src/app/self_order_index.js, root.js, its own router.js, plus pages/ services/ store/ models/ trees, mounted by the public /pos-self/<config_id> route and bundled in pos_self_order.assets (56 entries). 54 JS files / 37 XML templates / ~28 components (LandingPage, ProductListPage, ProductPage, ComboPage/ComboStepper, CartPage, PaymentPage, ConfirmationPage, OrdersHistoryPage, EatingLocationPage, StandNumberPage, plus self_order, router and printer client services). It patches the cashier app's PosStore/PosOrder/PosData/TicketScreen so kiosk/mobile orders surface in the till. This entire customer journey (menu browse, attribute/combo selection, cart, pay, track) is client logic not reverse-engineerable from Python metadata.

it_architecture.application: pos_self_order (POS Self Order: customer-facing kiosk + QR-menu OWL app layered on the Point of Sale terminal)
software_services: /pos-self/<config_id> (render the customer self-order SPA / QR menu)
/pos-self-order/process-order/<device_type>/ (submit a customer order into the live session)
information_flows: side-effect: process-order -> pos.order._check_pos_order -> sync_from_ui -> pos.order created inside config.current_session_id (shared with cashier)
side-effect: recompute_prices re-prices all lines server-side after every customer submission
side-effect: _send_notification -> config._notify (longpolling bus) -> cashier POS + kiosk screens live-refresh
access path: QR code (link.tracker short URL + access_token + table_identifier) -> /pos-self/<config_id> -> public SPA bound to self_ordering_default_user_id

capabilities: Capture Customer-Placed Orders into the POS session
Accept Kiosk Self-Payment at a terminal
Configure Self-Order Channel (modes, branding, languages, custom links)
Route Orders by Table / Stand / Pickup zone
value_streams: Self-Order-to-Counter: scan QR / approach kiosk -> browse menu -> build cart (attributes/combos) -> place order -> (kiosk) self-pay or (mobile) pay-after -> order injected into live pos.session -> kitchen/cashier notified -> fulfilment by POS
organization: self_ordering_default_user_id (the POS user public diners act as)
policies: self_ordering_mode gates the public route (404 unless consultation/mobile/kiosk)
constraint: no cash payment methods allowed in kiosk mode
constraint: self_ordering_default_user_id must be a POS user when mode != nothing
write() couples mode/service_mode to pay_after (kiosk & counter-mobile force pay-each)
server-side recompute_prices + access_token/consteq checks prevent frontend price/order tampering
metrics: pos.order.source breakdown (mobile vs kiosk vs POS) feeding report.pos.order
link.tracker click stats on self-order QR short URLs

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: pos_self_order is best read as a value NETWORK (Stabell & Fjeldstad mediating technology), not a chain. Unlike its parent point_of_sale -- which owns the sell/checkout value logic and triggers the downstream stock+account chain -- this module adds no new order/accounting value flow of its own: every customer order it captures is injected via sync_from_ui into the EXISTING pos.session and re-priced by the host POS. Its actual contribution is mediating infrastructure that links a new party (the diner) directly to the restaurant's POS service: a public OWL self-order app, a QR / access-token + link.tracker + table_identifier access layer (_get_self_order_url, _get_qr_code_data), and a longpolling bus (config._notify) that connects customer terminals to the cashier and kitchen in real time. That mediation between customers and the POS service -- with tiered membership (consultation / mobile / kiosk) and a self-payment terminal handshake -- is the value-network pattern. It is classed PRIMARY (a customer-facing revenue channel) and mapped to APQC 3.0 Market and Sell because self-ordering is a sales / order-capture channel for the point-of-sale family (consistent with the apqc_odoo_map sell-family rows and the point_of_sale parent record). Alternative considered: chain, because the orders ultimately flow into the chain-style POS pipeline; rejected because pos_self_order itself does not perform the inbound->operate->outbound conversion, it federates a customer channel onto the host that does.

standard_capabilities: mobile self-ordering with pay-after-meal or pay-each, table or pickup service
self-service kiosk mode with on-terminal self-payment (adyen/stripe/razorpay/pine_labs/viva_com)
per-table / generic QR code generation as downloadable PNG+SVG zip
branding, splash/background images, multi-language and custom action links on the self-order screen
orders synced live into the running pos.session with kitchen/cashier bus notifications
email receipt to customer via pos.preset mail template
typical_fits: restaurant QR-menu + table ordering on customer phones
fast-food / counter self-service kiosk with card terminal
channel toggled per till via pos.config self_ordering_mode (kiosk onboarding scenario provided)
common_gaps: custom self-order UI screens / journey changes (OWL dev on pos_self_order.assets, not config)
kiosk integration with an unsupported payment terminal (custom _payment_request_from_kiosk)
loyalty / promotions / upsell logic inside the self-order flow beyond standard pricelists & combos
bespoke order-routing or coursing rules beyond preset service_at
cash handling in kiosk (blocked by constraint -- requires alternative tender design)
drive_hints: odoo shell: env['pos.config'].browse(ID)._get_self_order_url()  # short QR URL via link.tracker
browse /pos-self/<config_id> to launch the customer self-order SPA

open_questions: Exact pos.order.state lifecycle for self-orders (draft -> paid) across mobile pay-after vs kiosk pay-each, and how _process_saved_order is triggered for paid (non-zero) orders.
How _payment_request_from_kiosk drives each supported terminal and returns status to the kiosk PaymentPage.
Conflict handling when multiple diners on the same table_identifier edit a shared draft order concurrently.
Full set of fields exposed publicly via _load_pos_self_data_fields and the data-minimization guarantees for anonymous access.
